elements.name: ACCSystem is a central marketplace platform, not an institution ERP
Each institution operates an independent ACCore instance
ACCommerce and ACCore Commerce Workspace share Commerce Core
ACCSystem stores marketplace projection of product data, not the source
Integration via APIs and events with Outbox/Inbox and idempotency
Inventory reservation performed at ACCore seller before order confirmation
Order Domain coordinates payment and delivery without owning their logic
ACCMared is a client UI; delivery backend logic lives in ACCSystem
ACManagement is a frontend client for Platform Management services
Software Catalog, License Management, and Identity are separate services
Platform admin and support access subject to least privilege, approval, scope, and audit
ACCSystem architecture style: bounded-context services over monolith
Saga pattern (orchestration) for distributed order transaction
Offline license validation via short-lived signed entitlement token
Institution connectivity and ACCore release trust
Multi-seller orders and auditable payment/settlement records
Configurable institutional policies and external gates
Reservation state machine UNKNOWN handling TTL policy and vocabulary canonicalization
Financial trigger scope and institutional accounting commitment point
C2 view scope declaration and C1 arrow convention
Configurable policy registry and no hard-coded thresholds
